scope: Repository qualification and publication policy for a specifically registered confirmed repair; this is not hardware acceptance or a GPU baseline change.
behavior: A scoped verified-fix may be qualified by one matching native case while its broader causal fault remains open.
The registered cause, source commit, exact component profile, independent code review and signed build are bound to three distinct retained proof files and full hashes.
The native case must be a separate evidence file on the one-time candidate boot and must actually load the repaired component.
An explicitly nonvisual empty-window scope may use output_required=false; normal exit and desktop continuity remain required. Visual scopes retain output verification.
A scoped repair cannot enter baseline_comparisons to omit open-fault accounting. Each open fault still requires its existing independent qualification record.
Historical closure-based verified-fix rules, their three original-scenario receipts and separate working control remain unchanged.
Support proof files remain hash-bound across later baseline selections and publication. Windows hash letter case is accepted.

relevant_negative_cases: Scoped repair cannot omit per-fault independent accounting
Static proof cannot substitute for native receipt
Incorrect source, input scope, component loading or support proof is rejected
Tampering with retained review after later baseline replacement is rejected

not_accepted_by_this_publication: Present1 candidate native Windows entry or hardware validation
Neon NVK candidate physical loading, rendering, desktop acceptance or measured performance
TDR/dump evidence chain or historical first-Present root cause
deployment_limits: Local pre-push installation completed through the normal --install command.
This main-review task made no device connection, immutable on-device policy update, permit change or hardware dispatch.
A hardware executor must use actual candidate receipts and the normal immutable policy workflow before promotion.
